verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents that every cloud browser runs in a hardened Chromium fork with stealth enabled by default, and that residential proxies are on by default across 195+ countries, billed at $5/GB. This covers the core of the story: stealth plus residential proxies. Missing for 10: documentation of how to select a specific country or geo-target per session, details of what the stealth fingerprinting actually covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these measures avoid bot blocking.
